name: office-ppt-deck-specialist
description: Create editable presentations and revise selected pages through the self-hosted PPT service.

displayName.zh: 资料成稿、逐页预览与指定页续改
displayName.en: Editable decks, previews and focused revisions

displayDescription.zh: PPT做得慢、改稿反复？上传选定资料，自有云生成可编辑页面、图表与讲稿，附逐页预览并支持指定页续改。
displayDescription.en: Use selected materials to create editable slides, native charts, notes and rendered previews; revise selected pages through the operator-hosted service.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请把我提供的资料做成3页商务汇报PPT，可将本次选中资料交给本专家自有云处理，交付可编辑PPTX、PDF和逐页预览。
